Actual forward RAW LUT and per-frame metadata are frozen with DMA; paired consumes exact produced codes

hypotheses: One-provider fresh-edge MAIN/auxiliary fairness is a finite virtual scheduling rule, not physical frame cadence
Exact-knot inverse metadata reconstructs a declared virtual linear domain; it is not a recovered Nikon decompander
CFA phase, fixed reference sensor responses, interpolation, matrix normalization, signed-chroma convention and numerical filter roles are finite modeled choices
limits: Color-primary channels clip under the original programmed matrix/curve profile; no calibrated photographic color claim
Host replacement-to-visible latency includes polling/image-analysis overhead and pipeline backlog; no camera FPS claim
